metadata.title: Hypervelocity stars from star clusters hosting Intermediate-Mass Black Holes

notes: No eligible individual stars: the paper is a population-synthesis study of unnamed synthetic stars. HD 271791 is only cited from prior work as a previously discovered unbound disc star (T:p1-b10; T:p14-b7), and LAMOST J115209.12+120258.0 is only reported from Boubert et al. as having an unbound orbit (T:p2-b1); neither is selected or analyzed in this paper. VFTS 16, VFTS682, and LAMOST-HVS1 are only cited as runaways/hyper-runaways with proposed origins (T:p14-b7), without an explicit present-day Galactic-unbound determination.
